title: Chvátal's degree-majorisation of nonhamiltonian graphs
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on $n \ge 3$ vertices, and suppose $G$ is not Hamiltonian. Then there is an integer $m$ with $0 < m$ and $2m < n$ such that $G$ is degree-majorised by $C_{m,n}$ (Chvátal, 1972).
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
conclusion: existence of m with 0 < m
conclusion: G is degree-majorised by C_{m,n}
replaced:
Thm 4.6: a nonhamiltonian simple graph with \texttt{$\nu$ $\ge$ 3} is degree-majorised
by some \texttt{C\_\{m,$\nu$\}}.

(Chv\'atal, 1972)  If $G$ is a nonhamiltonian simple graph with
$\nu \geq 3$, then $G$ is degree-majorised by some $C_{m,\nu}$.
